subject: GCP private offer: proposed burn cadence + co-sell accelerator sync
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Park <evelyn.park@helixcloud.com>
Cc: soojin.lee@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:32:00 -0800
Subject: GCP private offer: proposed burn cadence + co-sell accelerator sync

Hi Evelyn —

Great talking earlier. Per our call I attached a draft draw schedule that maps your Q1 usage forecast to the private-offer commit. We want to avoid frontloading invoices while ensuring we don’t under-provision your burst needs for the co-sell accelerator starting Jan 10.

Quick asks:
- Can you confirm target monthly SKUs (token-hour equivalent) for Jan–Mar? I put conservative numbers in tab "OpsInput" of the attached.
- Any procurement constraints around invoice dates or PO acceptance windows?
- Can GCP Partner Ops accept partial redemptions across two invoices in a single month, or do they require one redemption per PO?

If useful, Marissa can run an amortization view so you can see invoice timing vs cost recognition for your finance team.

Attached: helix_draw_schedule_v2.xlsx (worksheet notes inside).

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0124

[attachment: helix_draw_schedule_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 48 KB)]

From: Evelyn Park <evelyn.park@helixcloud.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0500
Subject: Re: GCP private offer: proposed burn cadence + co-sell accelerator sync

Ben —

Thanks for the spreadsheet. Quick answers from procurement/finance side:
- We can frontload up to ~40% in Jan but need the remainder spread across Feb–Mar for revenue recognition.
- Invoices: our PO can cover multiple redemptions in a month, but GCP partner ops historically prefers a single monthly redemption line item. If Redwood can consolidate multiple SKU redemptions under one monthly redemption, that would be ideal.
- We need the final commitment schedule and a signed PO by Dec 15 for our quarter close.

Also looping in GCP Partner Ops (copied) to confirm their redemption constraints.

Evelyn Park
Director, Cloud Procurement | HelixCloud
evelyn.park@helixcloud.com

[No attachment]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: RE: GCP private offer: proposed burn cadence + co-sell accelerator sync

Ben / Marissa —

Thanks — I pulled the attached amortization view and added a consolidation proposal: we batch Helix redemptions into one monthly redemption line but use token-level SKU mapping internally so partner ops sees a single invoice line while we still attribute usage internally by SKU. That should satisfy Helix finance and keep GCP partner ops happy.

Notes:
- If Helix will agree to the 40% Jan frontload, we can convert that to an early redemptive credit and tag the remaining commit to two monthly redemptions (Feb/Mar).
- There is a small rounding delta (~0.8%) when mapping token-hour SKUs to a single redemption; finance is usually okay but we should flag.

Attached: helix_amortization_view_v1.xlsx (internal calc).

Soojin
Head of Marketplace Ops | Redwood Inference
[attachment: helix_amortization_view_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 22 KB)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Park <evelyn.park@helixcloud.com>, GCP Partner Ops <gcp-partner-ops@google.com>
Cc: soojin.lee@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 08:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: GCP private offer: proposed burn cadence + co-sell accelerator sync

Evelyn / Partner Ops —

Following up with a proposed final cadence: 40% redemption in Jan (single monthly redemption line), 30% in Feb, 30% in Mar. Soojin's amortization file shows the invoice mapping and the <0.9% rounding delta.

Next steps we propose:
1) Helix signs PO and uploads to DocuSign (we can send DocuSign link) by Dec 10.
2) Redwood and Helix confirm final SKU mapping in the attached tab.
3) Redwood triggers the monthly redemptions with GCP Partner Ops (we'll queue Jan redemption for the week of Jan 4).

Evelyn — if Dec 15 is your hard deadline, can we aim for Dec 10 to give GCP Ops time to set the redemption window?

Ben

[attachment: helix_draw_schedule_v2.xlsx (updated), note: will upload signed_po_stub.pdf once we receive PO]

From: Evelyn Park <evelyn.park@helixcloud.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, GCP Partner Ops <gcp-partner-ops@google.com>
Cc: soojin.lee@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: GCP private offer: proposed burn cadence + co-sell accelerator sync

Ben / Soojin / Marissa —

That cadence works. Procurement committed to signing by Dec 9. I attached the signed stub (full PO will be uploaded to DocuSign and shared after signature). Please confirm you have the right contact at GCP Partner Ops for the redemption API trigger — we want to avoid manual delays.

Evelyn

[attachment: signed_po_stub.pdf (pdf, 12 KB)]
